localChanges: In the build menu, an item that would have to wait once paid for says so before you choose it, such as Settlers in a city of size 1: "Can't be completed until the city is size 2" (closes #970).
The build queue says the same beside a queued item, as things stand in the city now (#970).
When a build you've paid for has to wait, you're told once, and the notice goes once the build stops waiting or the city is lost (#970).
A build that is waiting shows a pause mark in the cities list and on the city's banner on the map, where "…" was before (#970).

log: When a city's build is paid for but held back, such as Settlers in a size-1 city, the game now says so each turn it waits, so the page can tell the player why nothing was built (civ-clone/web-renderer#970).
test: Settlers that would wait in a size-1 city say so before they are chosen, and each turn they wait (#8)

A ruleset can now say, beside any item a city could build or has queued, that it would wait once paid for, and can tell a player when a build they have paid for is waiting (civ-clone/web-renderer#970).
Nothing changes in a game until a ruleset and the page use it.
